questions.q: You lower denoise from 1 to 0.5 with 20 steps. What happens to the number of model calls?
questions.why: KSampler.set_steps builds a longer schedule and keeps the last 20 steps. The lab shows 40 evaluations in both rows.

questions.q: Your negative prompt seems to do nothing at CFG 1. Why?
options: The negative pass is skipped at CFG 1
questions.answer: The negative pass is skipped at CFG 1
questions.why: sampling_function sets the negative to None when cond_scale is close to 1, and uncond + (cond − uncond) × 1 is the positive alone anyway.

questions.q: Which is a fair test of euler against heun?
options: Both at the same number of evaluations
Heun at 40 steps and euler at 20
questions.answer: Both at the same number of evaluations
questions.why: Heun calls the model about twice per step, so equal steps gives it twice the work.

questions.q: Why does the 4-channel EmptyLatentImage work with a 16-channel model?
options: An all-zero latent is widened to the model's channel count
questions.answer: An all-zero latent is widened to the model's channel count
questions.why: fix_empty_latent_channels in comfy/sample.py repeats an all-zero latent to latent_format.latent_channels.

questions.q: In the lab, changing the seed barely moved the mean result. What does that tell you?
options: A new seed is a new draw from the same distribution
questions.answer: A new seed is a new draw from the same distribution
questions.why: Each sample moved, by 0.384 RMS, and the average of the whole set stayed.
